comments.text: The best thing you can do for the environment is maintain an old car. The carbon footprint and overall environmental impact of manufacturing ANY new vehicle, whether ICE or EV is huge. Raw materials have to be mined (using enormous energy intensive machines), transported (using huge trucks/ships/trains etc) and refined (in vast energy intensive plants). These then have to be transported again (further increasing the carbon footprint) to manufacturers who make components in enormous energy intensive facilities. These components are then transported again for assembly, and then the vehicles themselves are transported all over the world......and then you still need electricity or gas to run them anyway.
